:::{#exm-angle-unit-circle}
#### Three angles on the unit circle

- The points $(1, 0)$ and $(0, 1)$ are a quarter of the circle apart, so their angle is $\pi/2$.
- The points $(1, 0)$ and $(-1, 0)$ are half of the circle apart, so their angle is $\pi$.
- The point $(1, 0)$ and itself are $0$ apart, so their angle is $0$.

:::
